current_state: No ethics approval or institutional authorization exists. System is draft-only offline.
target_state: Valid ethics approval (waiver/exemption for LEVEL_A; full approval for LEVEL_B/C) AND institutional authorization letter signed by authorized representative.
required_control: Ethics committee review and approval before any real data entry. Institutional authorization before system production access.
evidence_required: IRB/IEC approval document or waiver letter; institutional authorization signed.
verification_method: Document review by independent qualified person.

domain: Conflict of Interest and Delegation Log
current_state: No COI declaration or delegation log exists. No role separation enforced.
target_state: Documented COI declarations for all study personnel. Signed delegation log with role-specific access. Separation of duties enforced.
required_control: Delegation log template; COI disclosure form; RBAC role map linked to delegation.
evidence_required: Signed COI forms; signed delegation log; RBAC configuration audit.
verification_method: Review of signed documents and system RBAC mapping.

domain: Reviewer Independence and Separation of Duties
current_state: Reviewer identity not authenticated. Reviewer independence not established. Single person can review own work.
target_state: Authenticated reviewers with documented independence. Separation: author ≠ reviewer. Audit trail links reviewer identity to attestation.
required_control: Identity management system (R1); role-based separation in workflow; audit events linked to authenticated user.
evidence_required: Identity verification records; RBAC separation proof; audit trail showing reviewer ≠ author.
verification_method: Technical audit + document review.

current_state: No real user accounts. No identity verification. System accepts any string as reviewer_reference.
target_state: Real institutional accounts with verified identity. No anonymous access to production data.
required_control: SSO integration with institutional identity provider (LDAP/SAML) or verified account system.
evidence_required: Identity provider integration test report; user provisioning procedure; account lifecycle policy.
verification_method: Penetration test; user account audit.

current_state: No MFA. No account lockout. No access revocation workflow.
target_state: MFA enforced for all production access. Automated account deactivation on role change or departure. Access review log.
required_control: MFA configuration; access revocation procedure; periodic access review schedule.
evidence_required: MFA enforcement test; sample access revocation test; access review log.
verification_method: Technical verification + procedure review.

current_state: No electronic signature. Reviewer attestation is a string field with no legal binding.
target_state: Defined electronic signature policy meeting applicable regulatory requirements. Audit trail captures signatory identity + timestamp + meaning of signature.
required_control: Electronic signature policy; signature capture mechanism linked to authenticated user identity.
evidence_required: Signed e-signature policy; technical demonstration of signature capture with user binding.
verification_method: Policy review + technical test.

current_state: No de-identification protocol. No re-identification risk assessment. PII guard is marker-based string check only.
target_state: Formal de-identification protocol (expert determination or safe harbor). Re-identification risk assessment before LEVEL_A pilot.
required_control: De-identification SOP; re-identification risk assessment by qualified data privacy expert; data classification policy.
evidence_required: De-identification SOP signed; risk assessment report; approval from ethics committee or data governance.
verification_method: Independent review of de-identification protocol and risk assessment.

current_state: No data minimization policy. No permitted-use restriction beyond DRAFT marker.
target_state: Documented data minimization policy. Permitted-use boundaries defined per study protocol. Secondary use restricted.
required_control: Data minimization policy; permitted-use agreement; data classification by sensitivity.
evidence_required: Signed policy document; evidence of minimum-necessary data set definition per protocol.
verification_method: Policy review; data field audit.

current_state: No production backup. No retention policy. Files stored on OneDrive without production DR plan.
target_state: Defined retention policy per applicable regulations. Automated backup with tested restore. DR plan with RTO/RPO targets.
required_control: Backup system configuration; retention schedule; DR plan document; backup restore test.
evidence_required: Backup configuration audit; restore test report; DR plan signed; RTO/RPO verified.
verification_method: Technical verification of backup restore; DR test with documented results.

current_state: Audit events are JSONL append-only in local files. No tamper-evident storage. No external audit log sink.
target_state: Tamper-evident audit trail with cryptographic integrity (hash chain or external log sink). Data provenance traceable to authenticated user + timestamp + action.
required_control: Cryptographic audit trail (hash chain or write-once storage); provenance metadata per record.
evidence_required: Audit trail integrity test; provenance trace demonstration; validation test report.
verification_method: Technical validation test; penetration test for audit log tampering.

current_state: No production CRF. System generates DRAFT artifacts only. No validated data entry form.
target_state: Validated production CRF matching approved protocol. User acceptance testing completed. Change control documented.
required_control: CRF design based on approved protocol; UAT test script; validation test report; change control log.
evidence_required: CRF design specification; UAT results; validation test report signed by PI.
verification_method: Independent validation review.

current_state: No edit checks. No data query workflow. System accepts any input without range or logic validation.
target_state: Validated edit checks enforcing range
risk_level: logic and consistency rules. Query management workflow with resolution tracking.
required_control: LEVEL_A LEVEL_B LEVEL_C
owner_role: Edit check specification; query management SOP; validation test for each edit check.
evidence_required: PI / EDC Vendor / Validation
verification_method: Edit check specification; validation test results; query management procedure.
go_no_go_dependency: Validation test review; sample query resolution audit.

current_state: No database lock capability. No controlled export. JSONL files can be appended indefinitely.
target_state: Database lock procedure with PI authorization. Controlled export producing audit-ready dataset. Post-lock change management.
required_control: Database lock SOP; controlled export procedure; post-lock change control.
evidence_required: Lock procedure document; export test with hash verification; post-lock amendment policy.
verification_method: Procedure review; technical lock/unlock test.

current_state: No formal validation package. No change control. Code changes are not qualified.
target_state: Complete validation package (IQ/OQ/PQ or equivalent) for all production software. Change control for all modifications to validated system.
required_control: Validation plan; IQ/OQ/PQ test protocols; change control SOP; version control with review.
evidence_required: Signed validation package; change control log; SOP for validated system changes.
verification_method: Independent validation review by qualified validator.

current_state: No eHospital connection. No approved data extraction boundary. No institutional authorization for data access.
target_state: Documented and institutionally approved read-only extraction boundary. Technical controls preventing write-back. Approved data fields list.
required_control: Data access agreement with hospital IT; approved field list; technical read-only enforcement; no write-back control.
evidence_required: Data access agreement signed; technical architecture review showing read-only; no write-back test.
verification_method: Technical review; penetration test for write-back prevention.

domain: Data Dictionary Mapping and Quality Reconciliation
current_state: No data dictionary. No field mapping from eHospital to research platform. No reconciliation procedure.
target_state: Documented data dictionary mapping eHospital fields to research variables. Reconciliation procedure for data quality.
required_control: Data dictionary mapping document; reconciliation SOP; data quality checks.
evidence_required: Data dictionary document; reconciliation procedure; test extraction with reconciliation results.
verification_method: Document review; test extraction quality check.

current_state: No AE/SAE workflow. No protocol deviation tracking. System has no safety reporting capability.
target_state: Validated AE/SAE reporting workflow with timeline enforcement. Protocol deviation log. Safety reporting to ethics committee and sponsor.
required_control: AE/SAE workflow; deviation log; safety reporting SOP; timeline alerts.
evidence_required: AE workflow validation test; SAE reporting SOP; deviation log template; timeline test.
verification_method: Safety workflow test; SAE timeline verification.

current_state: No monitoring plan. No central monitoring capability. No escalation pathway.
target_state: Approved monitoring plan. Central statistical monitoring capability. Escalation pathway to PI and sponsor.
required_control: Monitoring plan document; monitoring SOP; escalation matrix; central monitoring tool configuration.
evidence_required: Monitoring plan signed; escalation matrix approved; central monitoring tool validation.
verification_method: Document review; monitoring simulation.

current_state: No independent validation. No security testing. Self-assessed only.
target_state: Independent validation by qualified validator. Penetration test by independent security tester. Remediation of all critical findings.
required_control: Independent validation engagement; penetration test; CAPA for all critical findings.
evidence_required: Validation report signed by independent validator; penetration test report; CAPA closed.
verification_method: Independent review of validation and security test reports.

current_state: No operational pilot. No formal Go/No-Go review process. System has never operated with real institutional oversight.
target_state: Limited operational pilot (LEVEL_A) with formal Go/No-Go review by PI and independent reviewer before scaling to LEVEL_B or LEVEL_C.
required_control: Pilot protocol; Go/No-Go review checklist; independent reviewer.
evidence_required: Pilot completion report; Go/No-Go review sign-off; incident log from pilot.
verification_method: Review of pilot report and incident log by independent reviewer.
